title: Operation Overlord with Bodyguard and Fortitude deceptions

tellings.quote: So invasion of the operation overlord D-Day and the beaches of Normandy was cool. and Operation Bodyguard and Fortitude were fake because we never actually invaded Norway as we said we were going to do.

plain: A researcher named Eric Weinstein, speaking on Jesse Michels's podcast, uses the Second World War as an example: Operation Overlord, the real D-Day invasion of Normandy in 1944, was hidden behind fake plans called Bodyguard and Fortitude, which claimed the Allies would invade Norway. He says the invasion of Norway never happened, and he offers this to show how real secrets can be covered by deliberate false stories, which he suggests may also apply to UFO secrecy.
